I have a job that puts me 3 weeks on (21 days) and 1 week off (6.5 days). I swap schedules every time I come back on... So, I work 5A - 7P for 3 weeks, and then 5P - 7A my next set on. So, my gym schedule kind of gets fubar'd around. My weeks off are fine - I can commit a solid 2-3 hours every day for lifting/cardio/fun in the sun, but my weeks on can be hellacious in terms of getting in enough time.

I've been messing around with SL 5x5 for the last couple of months, and I've seen some good progress, but I'm really looking for a program that's got a wider set of lifting options. I like the structure of "group" work and it helps me stay focused.

Sorry for the wall of text, and can't wait to hear your advice!
